original_question: How much do galaxy-formation predictions change when semi-analytic models use merger trees generated by the classical extended Press-Schechter (EPS) formalism instead of merger trees extracted directly from numerical simulations, given that recent work indicates EPS may not adequately describe simulated merger trees?
